## Equity futures under pressure as Brent approaches $108 and FOMC meeting begins

Elevated oil prices alongside an active FOMC creates a dual inflation and rate headwind for growth and technology multiples; a hawkish Fed outcome compounded by persistent energy cost pressure would be a negative catalyst for the portfolio's high-multiple holdings.

- S&P 500, Dow, and Nasdaq futures are all under pre-market pressure.
- Brent crude is approaching the $108 level, flagged as a notable energy cost signal.
- The FOMC meeting has commenced, introducing near-term rate-decision uncertainty.
- Three simultaneous macro signals — oil prices, central bank action, and equity futures weakness — are converging in a single session.
